findings.observation: Front matter Version 2.1.0 and Last verified 2026-03-31 contradict in-body Версия 2.2.0 pointer-only contract.
findings.method: Read policy header and body version lines
findings.expected: Single version stamp and Last verified aligned with runtime ORCHESTRATION and AGENTS.md guardrails.
findings.actual: Header Version 2.1.0 / Last verified 2026-03-31 vs body Версия 2.2.0 dated implicitly newer.
findings.impact: Contributors cannot trust freshness of orchestration guidance; stale Cursor-specific Agent tool instructions may persist.
findings.root_cause: Partial edit updated body pointer without refreshing YAML-style header metadata.
findings.remediation: Unify version to 2.2.0 (or bump once), set Last verified to current review date, trim Cursor-only Agent tool wording or label as Cursor-only appendix.
validation: grep Version / Версия / Last verified in agent-orchestration-rules.md after edit

findings.method: Read mirror banner and status line; compare to AI_RUNTIME_MIRROR_OWNERSHIP unacceptable drift rules
findings.expected: Mirror copy avoids claiming runtime SSOT; runtime file .codex/agents/ORCHESTRATION.md holds status.
findings.actual: Lines 1-4 declare mirror; line 16 repeats active runtime source wording copied from canonical file.
findings.impact: Discoverability risk: operators may edit docs path believing it is authoritative runtime.
findings.root_cause: Mirror sync copies runtime header verbatim without normalizing status for published mirror layer.
findings.remediation: Replace status line in docs mirror with mirror-specific status or omit; keep edit-runtime-first banner.
